newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - LaVergne, Tenn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - LaVergne, Tenn.

text.p: Water and Sewer Revenue and Tax Bonds, Series 1997
Notice is hereby given that the Mayor of the City of LaVergne, Tennessee (the l receive sealed bids
only for the purchase of the City's $4,200,000 Water and Sewer Revenue and Tax Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds''), on an all or none basis, until 11:00 o'clock a.m., C.S.T., on
at the offices of the Mayor, City Hall, LaVergne,

Tennessee. The Bonds shall be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7%) per annum. The Bonds will be dated March 1, 1997, and will mature on March 1 in the years 1999 through 2017, inclusive. No bid will be considered for less than ninety-nine percent (99%) of par and accrued interest. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the Mayor of the City. The Bonds will be issued as qualified tax-exempt

obligations'' within the meaning of Section 265 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. The Bonds maturing March 1, 2006 and thereafter are callable March 1, 2005 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the City. Additional

information, including the Official Statement and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at City Hall, LaVergne, Tennessee 37086 or from First Tennessee Bank National Association, Attn: Jim Vogel, 845 Crossover Lane, Suite 150, Memphis, Tennessee 38117, telephone (1-800-456- 5460).
